correctness.rationale: The Horowitz-Katz-Katz conformal-class inequality gives \(\operatorname{area}(G)-y\operatorname{sys}(G)^2\ge\operatorname{Var}(f)\) in the reduced modular normalization. At fixed quotient distance from the Eisenstein class, minimizing the reduced height \(y\) over the half fundamental domain puts the minimizer on the unit-circle boundary until the square class and on the imaginary axis afterward. The resulting two formulas for \(y_{\min}(d)\) agree at \(d=\log\sqrt3\), and \(\Phi(d)=y_{\min}(d)-\sqrt3/2\). Constant conformal factors on the boundary flat tori attain equality.
residual_risks: The quotient-distance nearest-lift statement is standard for the modular reflection chamber and matches the independently published flat-profile derivation.
